Voice memory

Ideas strike anywhere.
Now they're kept.

Tap the ring and speak. Thirty minutes of offline recording — Kira Intelligence transcribes and summarizes it into clean, searchable notes, linking everything back to your brain.

Idea shorthand

Rambling thoughts in, structured notes out. Transcription runs through AI summarization so a two-minute voice memo becomes three bullet points — titled, timestamped, and synced to your brain.

An AI lab
on your finger.
